area: Keystone testbed: an isolated RandomStream for presentation variety

find.report_claim: rng is a Keystone module for deterministic SplitMix64 streams with safe forking and snapshot/restore, and was one of 21 modules the shooter had never imported
find.live_evidence: the sim deliberately owns two random.Random streams (combat and rewards) seeded from the run seed; replacing either would move the replay hash, and the shoot voice played at a fixed 0.7 gain on every shot
find.consumer_evidence: a forked stream gives per-shot gain variety without advancing either sim stream, and its RandomStreamState can be reported as JSON so an AI/soak run can reproduce the exact presentation sequence
